note: amd64 DEFAULT, installer and rescue kernel under the unified 7.3 policy (operator 2026-10-05, ported 2026-10-11 to v7.3-rc7). AER: Lukas Wunner's 79c168e2aa95 'PCI/AER: Skip error recovery on false alarms' is in v7.3-rc7 base (replaces the rc6-4 plain-revert 9010), and a narrow Apple SEP ANFE quirk 9011 (DECLARE_PCI_FIXUP_EARLY(APPLE, 0x1802, quirk_no_aer_anfe)) leaves the Apple T2 Secure Enclave's ANFE bit masked: 9010 is dropped, 9011 is the in-tree patch. Also carried: 9013 PCI/DPC enumeration guard (dev->aer_cap), 9101 integrity T2 cert-skip info, 9102 btbcm BCM4364B3 + T2 ROM firmware info. 9012 (nouveau gcx_ready NULL gsp->rm fix) is dropped because upstream 4d0e27041185 is already in v7.3-rc7. The kernel suffix moves from -t2-edge-aer9010 to -t2-ncz per the operator 2026-10-11 normalised naming decision (feat/normalize-t2-ncz-localversion-20261011); the rEFInd hook's is_stable_class already accepts *-t2-ncz* so the rescue/stable classification is unchanged. Replaced by the 7.3.0 final build later.
